name: Katsuya Ko
blocked: Own site's official PDF menu (sbe.com/pdf/katsuya-ko-menu-2026) lists every dish with no prices at all (a deliberate design choice). Third-party prices found for the same dish disagree beyond a rounding/fee markup (e.g. "Beef Bop" is $36.00 per OpenTable's structured menu listing vs $32 per a Yelp review quote for what appears to be the same bibimbap dish), so per the disagreement rule this is blocked rather than filed from either source; Yelp is also barred as a source outright.
